name: unsupported-constructs
purpose: Two things this version deliberately declines, side by side: CommonJS `require`, and an npm lockfile in a format it does not model. Both must be reported as declined, with no version guessed and no edge invented.
exercises: require is unsupported-syntax with the specifier and the line retained
an npm lockfile format this version does not model is named, not approximated
no resolved version is invented from a lockfile this version cannot read

inspiredBy.originalBehaviour: package-lock.json at lockfileVersion 1 is reported as "Lockfile format 1 is not modelled… left uninterpreted rather than approximated", and all 85 `require` calls in `lib/` are `unsupported-syntax`. express (9a34acf03cb818ff3f8bc40e44176e277a25cbb9) and webpack (e95be18b465117b38d4f260b608d4f084a500bdc) show the same for 402 and 3249 imports respectively.
